name: watercolor_anime
description: A watercolour anime-film cast set in a seaside town at golden hour. The boss runs the shop, the worker does the deliveries, the analyst explains what the numbers mean.
style: Japanese animated-film background art painted in soft watercolour and gouache, visible brush strokes and paper grain, warm golden-hour light with gentle bloom, thin hand-drawn outlines in warm brown rather than black, nostalgic palette of peach orange, cream, soft teal and dusty blue, cinematic hand-painted anime look, no hard cel shading

background.prompt: A quiet seaside-town street at golden hour seen straight on, painted in soft watercolour. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper third: a warm sunset sky with soft peach and cream clouds, a strip of glittering blue sea and a row of distant small tiled rooftops all staying behind the horizon line. Lower third: a sunlit asphalt road sloping gently toward the viewer, long warm shadows, a low white guardrail and small green hugging hedges only at the extreme left and right edges. Wide open empty sunlit middle with nothing in it.

boss.role: owns the shop and the capital - watches the till and the tide
boss.look: a tanned middle-aged shopkeeper, short greying hair, rolled-up white sleeves, a navy apron over a cream shirt, a small towel slung over one shoulder, dark cropped trousers, sandals

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, hands resting in his apron pockets, calm expression
poses.point: standing and pointing forward with one hand, mouth open, giving an instruction
poses.count: standing holding a small stack of coins in one palm, counting them with narrowed eyes
poses.worried: standing with one hand rubbing the back of his neck, brows drawn together
poses.happy: standing with both arms slightly raised, laughing with his eyes closed

worker.role: does the actual running around - deliveries, errands, the real work
worker.look: a bright young worker in a white short-sleeved uniform shirt with a small red neckerchief, navy shorts, white socks and brown loafers, short dark hair, a canvas shoulder bag

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms at the sides, easy smile
poses.run: running to the right at full speed, arms pumping, scarf and bag swinging, determined expression
poses.tired: standing with slumped shoulders and drooping eyelids, out of breath
poses.happy: standing with both arms raised in celebration, wide smile, eyes squeezed with joy
poses.confused: standing with one hand scratching the back of the head, puzzled look

analyst.role: the analyst who explains the mechanism with the chart
analyst.look: a composed young woman with a bob haircut and round thin-rimmed glasses, a cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, olive cropped trousers, a brown leather satchel across one shoulder

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, one hand holding the satchel strap, calm look
poses.explain: standing and gesturing with one open hand turned upward, mid-explanation
poses.point_up: standing and pointing upward with one index finger, making a single point
poses.think: standing with one hand at the chin, head slightly tilted, considering

props.shop_front: a small seaside shop front with a red-and-cream striped awning, wooden door and two windows, seen straight on, complete and small
props.bicycle: a classic step-through bicycle with a wicker basket on the handlebars, seen from the side, painted in soft teal
props.street_lamp: a slender cast-iron street lamp with a warm glowing lamp head
props.market_stall: a small wooden market stall with a striped canopy and an empty counter, seen from the front
props.wooden_table: a long plain wooden garden table seen from the front, weathered surface
props.chalkboard_menu: an A-frame chalkboard standing on the ground, blank dark writing surface in a wooden frame
props.whiteboard: a plain white presentation board in a light wooden frame, blank writing surface, standing upright
props.chart_up: a simple bar chart painted on a cream card, four bars rising left to right, a soft green upward arrow above them
props.chart_down: a simple bar chart painted on a cream card, four bars falling left to right, a soft red downward arrow above them
props.clock: a plain round wall clock with a white face, black hands and a thin wooden rim
props.coins: a small heap of warm gold coins with painted highlights
props.money_bag: a plump beige cloth money bag tied at the neck with rope
props.delivery_van: a small rounded delivery van seen from the side, cream body with a teal stripe, no writing
props.fish_crate: an open wooden crate of fresh silver fish on a bed of ice

_panel_color_note: Warm cream, matching the gouache paper tone, so a panel reads as a sunlit interior wall rather than a sticker on the sunset plate.
